card.title: Hero gear
card.description: Every hero wears all {{pieces}} pieces. Their level is your Hero Enhancement research ({{research}}/{{max}}, in the Academy); stars are bought with medals. A hero uses gear levels and stars up to its gear tier: none at hero levels 1-9, 1 at 10-19, … 9 at 90-99, all {{max}} at level {{heroMaxLevel}}. Every level of a piece adds +{{levelPoints}}, and its star N adds +N. Set bonus: +{{setBonus}} for every star level all {{pieces}} pieces have reached.
